The Clever Monkey and the Greedy Crocodile. A jungle adventure, full of tricks and laughter!
Once upon a time, there lived a clever little monkey in a beautiful tropical jungle.
One day, the monkey wanted to cross a wide river. But the river was very deep, and the water flowed strongly.
There were no trees nearby, so he couldn't jump from one tree to another.
The monkey sat on the riverbank, scratching his head, and wondering how he could get to the other side.
Oh dear! How am I going to cross this river?
Suddenly, a crocodile appeared from the water.
Hello, my little friend! Why are you sitting here looking so sad?
I want to cross the river, but I don't know how!
That's easy! Climb onto my back. I'll carry you safely across the river.
Really? That's very kind of you!
The monkey happily climbed onto the crocodile's back, and they started swimming across the river.
But the crocodile had a secret plan.
Hehehe! Once we reach the middle of the river, I'll dive underwater, and make this little monkey my dinner!
Everything seemed fine as they swam through the water.
But when they reached the middle of the river, the crocodile suddenly began to dive underwater.
Hey! Hey! What are you doing?
The crocodile didn't say a word. Instead, he thought:
You fool! Don't you know I'm going to eat you?
The monkey was terrified. He suddenly realized the danger, and knew he had to think quickly to save himself.
Suddenly, an idea came to his mind.
Oh, I almost forgot! I want to bring my auntie with me. She's waiting on the riverbank.
She's very fat, and much bigger than me. She's too heavy to walk, so she needs a ride.
I'm just a skinny little monkey, but my auntie is a much bigger meal!
Hmm! If I take him back, I can get two monkeys instead of one!
And if his auntie is really that fat, I'll have a much bigger meal!
That's a wonderful idea! Let's go back and get your auntie!
The crocodile quickly turned around, and swam back towards the riverbank.
As soon as they reached the shore, the clever monkey jumped off, and quickly climbed up a nearby tree.
Then he looked down at the crocodile, and burst out laughing.
Ha! Ha! Ha! Do you really think I'm a fool? You tried to trick me, but I'm much cleverer than you!
The crocodile looked up in surprise.
Hey! Come back! Where is your auntie?
My auntie? She's safe at home!
And you can forget about your dinner!
The crocodile floated sadly in the river, with an empty stomach.
The monkey sat comfortably on a tree branch, enjoying his victory.
Next time, don't underestimate a clever monkey!
And that's how the clever little monkey escaped from the greedy crocodile.
The moral of the story: Intelligence is more powerful than strength. A clever mind can save you from any danger.
